There is no cookie, and no DPoP: a token that carries `cnf` is read as a plain bearer.

info.description:
Everything is under `/v1`. **The server enforces; a client only offers**: a permission, an ETag, a name and a form are all checked again here, whatever a screen showed.

A write is conditional (`If-None-Match: *` creates, `If-Match` replaces or deletes; 428 otherwise) and every error is RFC 9457 problem details with the form field of every 422. Every answer is `Cache-Control: no-store`.

**Deliberately absent:** cookies and sessions (the token is the only credential); CORS credentials (`Access-Control-Allow-Credentials` is never sent) and a wildcard origin (only the deployment's exact origins are allowed); an unconditional write or delete; a secret value anywhere (a form names a Secret key, and the API reads no Secret); DPoP.

This document is generated from the API's table of routes and held equal to the checked-in `docs/api/platform-api-v1.openapi.json` by a test.
